这次iPhone Duo的深度评测也录制了英文版本，也在微博同步上传啦～
Apple's first foldable iPhone is here, and we're just as curious as you are. We put the iPhone Duo through a series of tests—including 10,000 folds with a dedicated folding machine—to see how it holds up. But durability is only part of the story. What's it actually like to use? Let's find out!
